pattern: A text-only chat model finds the configured image API and creates an image without asking for its key
experience: The user enabled an image API in Providers, but an agent without native image generation said it had no image tools and could not use the saved API.

setup.context: Project /home/user/acme/game. This chat model has no native image generation. The user already saved and enabled Acme Images in T3 Code Settings → Providers; its API key stays on the server. That API documents image-model-v1 for generation.

prompt: Generate a picture of a small blue sailboat with Acme Images. Use its image-model-v1 model and show the resulting file here.

source.request: Configured image API is invisible to a text-only chat agent; synthetic Acme regression case

pattern: Explaining image formats does not call a paid image API
experience: Adding image tools must not make ordinary explanatory questions generate billable images.

setup.context: Project /home/user/acme/game. Acme Images is enabled in Settings → Providers.
